entry_points.name: HRMS_LOGIN form open
entry_points.notes: System entry point. Password transmitted cleartext via Oracle Forms channel. No account lockout.

entry_points.name: PKG_SECURITY.authenticate
entry_points.notes: CRITICAL: Does not verify password hash (USER_CREDENTIALS table absent from schema). Creates session in USER_SESSIONS.

entry_points.name: HRMS_MENU open (post-login)
entry_points.trigger: Called by HRMS_LOGIN OPEN_FORM('HRMS_MENU') on successful login
entry_points.notes: MDI shell. Permission-gates Payroll, Reports, Admin menu items. Leave and Performance ungated.

entry_points.name: PKG_EMPLOYEE.create_employee
entry_points.notes: Triggers cascade: creates salary record, queues welcome email, logs audit. Race condition in generate_emp_number.

entry_points.name: PKG_EMPLOYEE.search_employees
entry_points.notes: SQL INJECTION vulnerability: p_last_name and p_first_name concatenated into dynamic SQL without bind variables.
entry_points.evidence: plsql/packages/PKG_EMPLOYEE.pkb search_employees — dynamic SQL literal concatenation

entry_points.name: PKG_EMPLOYEE.terminate_employee
entry_points.trigger: Invoked from HRMS_EMPLOYEE form status change (inferred — no explicit form trigger shown)
entry_points.notes: Final paycheck calculation (TODO), COBRA enrollment (TODO), and PKG_SECURITY access revocation (TODO) are unimplemented.

entry_points.name: PKG_PAYROLL.create_payroll_run
entry_points.notes: Creates a PAYROLL_RUNS record with PENDING status. Validates PAYROLL VIEW permission.

entry_points.name: PKG_PAYROLL.calculate_payroll
entry_points.trigger: BTN_CALCULATE on HRMS_PAYROLL form (PENDING status only)
entry_points.notes: Row-by-row cursor loop over all active employees. Long-running for large orgs — UI blocks. Partial commit risk.

entry_points.name: PKG_PAYROLL.approve_payroll
entry_points.trigger: BTN_APPROVE on HRMS_PAYROLL form (PAYROLL APPROVE permission required)
entry_points.notes: Triggers GL journal file generation (inferred — PKG_INTEGRATION.generate_gl_journal called from batch after approval).

entry_points.name: PKG_LEAVE.submit_leave_request
entry_points.notes: 5-day backdating limit. Balance check only for accrual types. Auto-approves if leave type REQUIRES_APPROVAL='N'.

entry_points.name: PKG_LEAVE.run_monthly_accrual
entry_points.trigger: DBMS_SCHEDULER job (assumed monthly — not defined in source)
entry_points.notes: Commits every 100 employees — partial commit risk on failure. Scheduler job definition not in source code.
entry_points.evidence: plsql/packages/PKG_LEAVE.pkb run_monthly_accrual; PKG_LEAVE header comment 'Monthly accrual job'

entry_points.name: PKG_NOTIFICATION.process_queue
entry_points.trigger: DBMS_SCHEDULER job — inferred every 5 minutes from PKG_NOTIFICATION comment
entry_points.notes: One SMTP connection per email. Retries up to 3 times via retry_failed. SMTP hard-coded to smtp.internal.company.com:25.
entry_points.evidence: plsql/packages/PKG_NOTIFICATION.pkb — comment '-- Recommended: run every 5 minutes'

entry_points.name: PKG_INTEGRATION.generate_gl_journal
entry_points.trigger: DBMS_SCHEDULER nightly batch after payroll approval (not in source)
entry_points.output: Flat file — pipe-delimited GL journal to Oracle Financials directory
entry_points.notes: Output: PAYROLL_JOURNAL_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.txt in GL_FEED_OUT directory. Oracle Financials reads via file polling.

entry_points.name: PKG_INTEGRATION.export_benefits_feed
entry_points.output: Fixed-width file — 203-char records to ADP benefits system in BENEFITS_FEED_OUT directory
entry_points.notes: ADP vendor-specific fixed-width format. FTP credentials stored cleartext in SYSTEM_PARAMETERS.

entry_points.name: PKG_INTEGRATION.import_time_attendance
entry_points.notes: CSV parsing is a TODO comment. Feature is incomplete.

entry_points.name: PKG_AUDIT.purge_old_records
entry_points.trigger: DBMS_SCHEDULER job (not in source — assumed nightly or weekly)
entry_points.notes: No scheduler job definition found in source. Must be configured manually.
entry_points.evidence: plsql/packages/PKG_AUDIT.pkb purge_old_records — default 365 day retention comment

entry_points.name: PKG_LEAVE.process_carryover
entry_points.trigger: DBMS_SCHEDULER annual job at fiscal year-end (not in source)
entry_points.notes: Caps carryover at CARRYOVER_MAX. Double-run risk if job fires twice on same day.

entry_points.name: PKG_PERFORMANCE.generate_reviews_for_cycle
entry_points.trigger: Called from HRMS_PERFORMANCE form when review cycle is OPENED
entry_points.output: PROCEDURE — creates PERFORMANCE_REVIEWS rows for all active employees with manager
entry_points.notes: Row-by-row loop. Large orgs will be slow. Employees without MANAGER_EMP_ID are skipped silently.

external_interfaces.name: Oracle Financials General Ledger
external_interfaces.mechanism: UTL_FILE write to GL_FEED_OUT Oracle Directory + file polling by Financials
external_interfaces.data: Payroll journal entries — department, account codes, debit/credit amounts
external_interfaces.risk: No retry, no acknowledgment. Failed writes are silently lost.

external_interfaces.name: ADP Benefits Administration
external_interfaces.protocol: Fixed-width flat file (203 chars per record) + FTP
external_interfaces.mechanism: UTL_FILE write to BENEFITS_FEED_OUT directory; FTP upload (credentials in SYSTEM_PARAMETERS)
external_interfaces.risk: FTP credentials stored cleartext. Fixed-width format brittle to ADP format changes.

external_interfaces.name: Time & Attendance System
external_interfaces.mechanism: UTL_FILE read from TIME_ATTENDANCE_IN Oracle Directory
external_interfaces.risk: CRITICAL: import_time_attendance is a TODO stub. This integration is NOT functional.

external_interfaces.name: Internal SMTP / Email Server
external_interfaces.data: HR workflow notifications (leave approval, hire confirmation, payroll notices, performance review requests)
external_interfaces.risk: SMTP server hard-coded. No TLS. Plaintext email. One connection per email.
